# ForeachOverNonIterable

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="native" /> <Badge type="info" text="off by default" />

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs)

Report a `foreach` over a value that the code itself shows is neither an
array nor an object. PHP raises a warning and skips the loop.

## Example

```php{4}
<?php
function total(int $count): void
{
    foreach ($count as $item) {
    }
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 4: Iterate over an array or an object, not int.</li>
</ul>

## Detection

- The subject of a `foreach`.
- The type of the subject comes from native declarations only, and every
  member of it is an int, a float, a string, a bool or null.

## Exceptions (no report)

- A subject of unknown type, or one that may be an array, an object,
  `iterable`, `callable` or `mixed`: a `foreach` walks the properties of any
  object.
- A type that comes only from PHPDoc.

## Fix

None.

## PHP versions

No gating.

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "ForeachOverNonIterable": {
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file):

```php
// @custos-ignore ForeachOverNonIterable
```
